fields.label: Automatic notifications
fields.description: Enable delivery of new library content. Schedule the New content task every minute.

fields.label: Matrix homeserver
fields.description: HTTPS base URL of the Matrix server, not the Element website.

fields.label: Matrix bot account
fields.description: Full Matrix user ID for the account that sends notifications.

fields.label: Matrix access token
fields.description: Access token for a dedicated Surimatrix device. Keep the same token when updating.

fields.label: Matrix device ID
fields.description: Device ID belonging to the bot access token. Do not reuse an Element device.

fields.label: Encrypted room ID
fields.description: Internal Matrix room ID. The bot must have joined this encrypted room.

fields.label: Persistent storage directory
fields.description: Absolute writable directory inside Silo’s container. Stores Matrix keys and pending notifications.

fields.label: Silo server URL
fields.description: HTTPS base URL of this Silo server.

fields.label: Silo administrator API key
fields.description: One administrator API key without scope restrictions, used for both library changes and item posters. A monitor-only key cannot read item details.

fields.label: Silo username (optional)
fields.description: Normal username of the API key owner. Leave empty to detect it automatically. The primary profile is selected automatically.

fields.label: Notification title (optional)
fields.description: Leave empty to use the server name from Silo settings. Set a custom title only to override it.

presentation.summary: Encrypted Matrix notifications for new Silo library content.
presentation.description_markdown: Send new movies and episodes directly from Silo to an encrypted Matrix room, with native poster attachments, episode grouping and persistent delivery state. Administrator access only.
presentation.setup_markdown: Configure the Silo administrator API key, Matrix bot, encrypted room and a writable persistent directory. Open Surimatrix to check the connection and send a poster test. Enable automatic notifications and schedule the New content task every minute.
